# matrix shape

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:matrixShape`](gmeow-matrixShape.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/matrixShape>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The shape descriptor of a [`CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) (e.g. '4×1' for a colourspace tuple, '256×1' for a spectral vector, '640×480×3' for a thermal image). Enables the solver layer to parse [`matrixValue`](gmeow-matrixValue.md) correctly without inferring shape from the literal content ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:matrixShape`](gmeow-matrixShape.md) from [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
